hooks.command: i=$(cat); case $i in *commit*|*push*) printf '%s' "$i" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/refuse-git-hook-skip.ps1";; esac
i=$(cat); case $i in *py*'<<'*) printf '%s' "$i" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/refuse-python-heredoc.ps1";; esac
i=$(cat); case $i in *gh*pr*|*gh*issue*) printf '%s' "$i" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/refuse-pr-body.ps1" -CiteSiblings -RequireSummaryVisual;; esac
i=$(cat); case $i in *'`'*) printf '%s' "$i" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/refuse-backtick-substitution.ps1";; esac

i=$(cat); case $i in *npm*|*npx*|*pip*|*gem*|*cargo*|*winget*|*choco*|*scoop*|*release*download*|*.exe*|*.msi*|*.zip*|*.tar.gz*|*.tgz*) printf '%s' "$i" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/ask-before-download.ps1";; esac
i=$(cat); case $i in *cat*|*py*|*'<<'*|*'\\\\'*) printf '%s' "$i" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/refuse-hanging-bash.ps1";; esac
